You often become slowed when damaged by fire.
messages.translation: 受到火焰伤害时，你经常会陷入缓慢状态。

messages.english: You often become weak and blind when damaged by cold.
messages.translation: 受到寒冷伤害时，你经常会虚弱并失明。

messages.english: You often become unable to move when damaged by electricity.
messages.translation: 受到电击伤害时，你经常会无法移动。

messages.english: Your slaying and spellpower are decreased in confined spaces.
messages.translation: 处于狭窄空间时，你的杀戮加成和法术强度降低。

messages.english: Your evasion is greatly reduced on turns you move or wait in place.
messages.translation: 在你移动或原地等待的回合中，你的闪避值大幅降低。

messages.english: You feel a strange sense of nostalgia.
messages.translation: 你感到一种奇怪的怀旧之情。

messages.english: You heal other nearby enemies whenever you kill a monster.
messages.translation: 每当你杀死一个怪物，就会治疗附近的其他敌人。

messages.english: Enemies in your sight sometimes split into clones of themselves.
messages.translation: 视野内的敌人有时会分裂出自身的复制体。

messages.english: You are less proficient with several skills.
messages.translation: 你的数项技能熟练程度降低。

messages.english: Enemies you spot sometimes become touched by paradox.
messages.translation: 你发现的敌人有时会受到悖论影响。

messages.english: Enemies you encounter may be immune to damage from range.
messages.translation: 你遇到的敌人可能免疫远距离造成的伤害。

messages.english: When enemies are summoned, they will appear beside you instead.
messages.translation: 敌人被召唤时，会改为出现在你身旁。

messages.english: When alone and injured, reapers sometimes come to claim you.
messages.translation: 独处且受伤时，收割者有时会前来索命。

messages.english:
Welcome to Hell!
Please enjoy your stay.
messages.translation:
欢迎来到地狱！
祝你住得愉快。

messages.english: An ancient malice corrodes your equipment.
messages.translation: 古老的恶意腐蚀着你的装备。

messages.english: Your scrolls appear blurry in the acrid smoke.
messages.translation: 刺鼻的烟雾中，你的卷轴显得模糊不清。

messages.english: Your potions freeze solid in the terrible cold.
messages.translation: 酷寒使你的药水冻成了坚冰。

messages.english: This decaying realm drains your will.
messages.translation: 这个衰败的领域消磨着你的意志。

messages.english:
Welcome to the Realm of Zot!
You feel the power of the Orb interfering with translocations here.
messages.translation:
欢迎来到佐特领域！
你感到宝珠的力量正干扰着此地的位移魔法。

messages.english:
You enter the halls of Pandemonium!
To return, you must find a gate leading back.
messages.translation:
你进入了魔窟的殿堂！
若想返回，必须找到一扇通向来处的门。

messages.english: You land on top of a ziggurat so tall you cannot make out the ground.
messages.translation: 你落在一座高耸神塔的顶端，高得连地面都看不清。
你进入了一座跨维度市集！
你进入了一间巫师实验室！

messages.english: You enter a great desolation of salt!
messages.translation: 你进入了辽阔的荒盐之地！
你进入了奥格瓦如的竞技场！

messages.english: You are dragged down into the Crucible of Flesh!

messages.translation: 你进入了一座华丽的亡者之城！
费了一些力气才抵抗住。
几乎毫不费力地抵抗了。

messages.english: You feel firmly anchored in space.
messages.translation: 你感到自己被牢牢锚定在空间中。

messages.english: You feel more firmly anchored in space.
messages.translation: 你感到自己被更牢固地锚定在空间中。
你感到自己的魔法受到了污染。
你感到自己的魔法受到的污染更深了。
